about_the_game:
Three days until the baby arrives. Three days to save the world.

Welcome to the House

A new baby is coming in three days! There’s so much to do, especially if Barty Bear is to prevent the Colic from returning once again. Luckily, with the help of the Bubble Fairy, Barty has all the time he needs. Explore the House to recover the lost puppies who hold the key to stopping this calamity. Or choose to go in a completely different direction, discovering several alternate plans to save the day.

At any point during the three-day cycle, you can choose to loop back in time to the morning of the first day. But before you restart, the Bubble Fairy will let you keep some things with you. Powerups, relationship statuses, quest progress... you have the freedom to choose exactly how to start the new cycle!

In this demo of the full game, you'll get a chance to:

  • Master the time loop by choosing exactly when Barty returns to the morning of his first day in the House.

  • Explore the first two sections of The House: Stuffie's Town and the Kitchen. Find secrets, collectables, and new friends around every corner!

  • Execute strategic decisions as to who or what is not reset with the change in time. This includes NPCs memories and relationships, collectables gained, and powerups discovered.

  • End the three day cycle on your own terms, whenever you think Barty has done enough to prepare for the oncoming Colic. Your preparations and discoveries will dictate what the future holds for the toys in the House in one of three possible endings for the demo!

  • Meet and get to know dozens NPCs in the demo alone, each with their own personality, and trackable likes and dislikes.

  • Maintain Barty's relationship with every single toy in the demo, and choose whether to save that relationship in the time loop or reset it.

  • Romance one of the twelve Old Toys, Ava Cado. If you wish, you can gain her trust and provide her with comfort throughout the trying three days. Be careful though! A negative relationship with her has its consequences! Barty will soon find himself in the middle of a boss fight if he doesn't mind his manners!

  • Battle through hoards of hostile Rottens, food that has gone bad in the Kitchen. The demo also includes four of the 40 boss battles from the full game.

  • Harness the abilities of three kid-tested, parent-approved powerups. Barty will need them all in order to save the day!

  • Collect a whole bunch of other helpful items as well, such as storybook pages, puzzle pieces, and letter blocks!
